WAYFINDER.Title: Auto-Grid
WAYFINDER.Warn.ViewScene: WAG: You must 'View' this scene on the canvas to use the visual alignment tool.
WAYFINDER.Info.Rescaled: WAG: Scene rescaled — grid locked at exactly {size}px, offset {x}, {y}.
WAYFINDER.Header.Subtitle: Align your map to the grid in one step.
WAYFINDER.Error.NoView: Please view a Scene to use this tool.
WAYFINDER.Detect.Info.NoGrid: WAG: No drawn grid detected. Trace a 3x3 box instead.
WAYFINDER.Detect.Warn.NoImage: WAG: The map image could not be read.
WAYFINDER.Detect.Warn.SquareOnly: WAG: Automatic detection needs a square or hex grid type set on the scene.
WAYFINDER.Detect.AlreadyAligned: WAG: Grid already aligned — {size}px at offset {x}, {y}.
WAYFINDER.Detect.Confirm.Title: Auto-Detect
WAYFINDER.Detect.Confirm.Body: Detected a {size}px grid at offset {x}, {y}; the scene is currently set to {current}px. Align the scene to the detected grid?
WAYFINDER.Detect.Orientation.Title: Hex Orientation
WAYFINDER.Detect.Orientation.Body: This map's hexes look {detected}, but the scene is set to {current}. Switch the scene to {detected} and align it to a {size}px grid?
WAYFINDER.Square.Instruction: Draw a 3x3 box on the map to automatically calculate grid size and offset with our Visual Alignment Tool.
WAYFINDER.Square.Help.Description: Click Detect Grid and Auto-Grid reads the grid, the offset, and any needed rescale straight off the map. Or click Draw 3x3 Box and drag a box over exactly 3 grid squares wide and 3 grid squares tall on your map image. You can't pan after you enable the draw, so zoom and position your map beforehand. Right-click or press Escape to cancel.
WAYFINDER.Square.Warn.GridSizeOutOfRange: WAG: Calculated grid size ({size}px) is out of range ({min}–{max}px). Try drawing a box closer to your grid squares.
WAYFINDER.Square.Rescale.Title: Auto-Rescale
WAYFINDER.Square.Rescale.Header: This map does not fit a whole-pixel grid
WAYFINDER.Square.Rescale.Body: This map measures out to {cols}x{rows} edge-to-edge cells of about {period}px each. No whole-pixel grid can match that exactly; a {size}px grid drifts roughly {drift}px across the map.
WAYFINDER.Square.Rescale.BodyMeasured: The map's drawn grid measures about {period}px per cell. No whole-pixel grid can match that exactly; a {size}px grid drifts roughly {drift}px across the map.
WAYFINDER.Square.Rescale.Question: Stretch the scene to {newWidth}x{newHeight}px (a {stretch}% resize) so every cell becomes exactly {size}px at offset {offsetX}, {offsetY}?
WAYFINDER.Hex.Instruction: Place a 3-hex triangle overlay on your map to automatically calculate grid size and offset with our Visual Alignment Tool.
WAYFINDER.Hex.Info.PlaceTriangle.PointyT: WAG: Scroll to resize (hold Shift for fine 1px steps), drag the triangle over 3 adjacent hex cells, then click to confirm.
WAYFINDER.Hex.Info.PlaceTriangle.FlatTop: WAG: Scroll to resize (hold Shift for fine 1px steps), drag the triangle over 3 adjacent hex cells, then click to confirm.
WAYFINDER.Hex.Help.Description: Click the button to place a 3-hex triangle overlay on your map. Scroll to resize it (hold Shift for fine 1px steps) until the three cells match your grid, drag to position it over any cluster of adjacent hex cells, then click to confirm. Right-click or press Escape to cancel.
WAYFINDER.Hex.Warn.GridSizeOutOfRange: WAG: Calculated grid size ({size}px) is out of range ({min}–{max}px). Try resizing the hex overlay closer to your actual hex cells.
